notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the six-opcode bank wire: CMSG_BANKER_ACTIVATE, SMSG_SHOW_BANK, CMSG_BUY_BANK_SLOT, SMSG_BUY_BANK_SLOT_RESULT, plus CMSG_AUTOBANK_ITEM (deposit) and CMSG_AUTOSTORE_BANK_ITEM (direction-tolerant withdraw). MSUI implements the window-open/buy-slot four but moves items across the bank boundary with generic CMSG_SWAP_ITEM (Program.Bank.cs computes destination slots client-side) instead of the reference auto-move opcodes.
